scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.generate: npm run generate -w contract && npm run generate -w web && npm run generate -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
